integrity: Exact analytic proofs of majorization and all equality cases, plus a standalone Python 3 exact-rational checker; mathematical self-review only. Classical matrix inequalities, Gramian tools and Fourier diagonalization are credited, not new.
scientific_limitations: Uniformly damped directed cyclic permutation, one fixed freely oriented real scalar actuator of unit norm, horizons at least n or infinity, no noise; not an arbitrary circulant network theorem. Related circulant-network thesis chapter full text unavailable: specialized historical equivalence cannot be excluded.
title: Horizon-universal spectral majorization for a damped cyclic actuator
